main_text.head: CAPUT XIII.
Tabula, qua adumbratur series artis Topicæ.
main_text.p: UT videas cohærentiam hujus systematis Topico-Mnemonici, en tibi tabulam, qua illius methodus tibi ὡς ἐν σκιᾷ[?] exhibetur.

page.notes: The diagram is a tree of braces; levels are read from the depth of the braces and are approximate where the lines run close together. The Greek phrase in the opening paragraph is hard to read and is marked [?]. The margin of the page carries no notes.
